```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`db_to_pq()` exports PostgreSQL tables to Parquet using a DBI connection. It can
filter rows, select columns, rename outputs, and apply Arrow type overrides.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
db_to_pq(
  table_name = "company",
  schema = "comp",
  data_dir = "~/pq_data",
  keep = c("gvkey", "conm"),
  rename = c(conm = "company_name"),
  col_types = list(company_name = "string")
)
```

Use `db_schema_tables()` to inspect available relations and `db_schema_to_pq()`
to export a schema.
